definitions.explanation: Falling or plunging with the head or top downward, straight down. Almost always used with に as an adverb before a verb of falling.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っ{逆|さか}さま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{真|ま}っ{逆|さか}さま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転|ころ}げ{落|お}ちた。
examples.english: I tumbled headfirst down the stairs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{逆|さか}さま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧いく⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I dreamed of a plane plunging straight down into the sea.

notes:
{真|ま}っ (emphatic prefix) + ⟦{逆|さか}さま→逆さま：17232_sakasama⟧ (upside down).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真|ま}っ{逆|さか}さま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to fall headlong
- {真|ま}っ{逆|さか}さま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転落|てんらく}→転落：19790_tenraku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to plunge headfirst

WRITING:
- Also written {真|ま}っ{逆様|さかさま}.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{逆|さか}さま→逆さま：17232_sakasama⟧: upside down; the wrong way round
